title: CLAIR: Consistent LLM Adaptation via Index-free Reprogramming
abstract: arXiv:2611.28721v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time-series forecasting with pretrained large language models (LLMs) uses contextualized patch representations, raising the question of how to align them. Matching patches at the same temporal position is natural, but self-attention allows each patch state to incorporate information from elsewhere in the input window, suggesting that useful correspondences can extend across positions. This flexibility, however, does not necessarily translate into consistent forecasts: similar patch states may play different roles when used in their original temporal order. To address both issues, we propose CLAIR (Consistent LLM Adaptation via Index-free Reprogramming), a teacher-guided framework that combines patch-level transport alignment (PTA) and forecast-level consistency (FC). translated_title: CLAIR：通过无索引重编程实现一致的LLM适配
translated_abstract: 使用预训练大语言模型（LLM）进行时间序列预测依赖于上下文化的补丁表示，这引出了如何对齐这些表示的问题。在相同时间位置匹配补丁是一种自然的做法，但自注意力机制允许每个补丁状态融入来自输入窗口其他位置的信息，这表明有用的对应关系可以跨越不同时间位置。然而，这种灵活性并不一定能转化为一致的预测：相似的补丁状态在按原始时间顺序使用时可能扮演不同的角色。为了解决这两个问题，我们提出了CLAIR（通过无索引重编程实现一致的LLM适配），这是一个教师引导的框架，结合了补丁级传输对齐（PTA）和预测级一致性（FC）。一个干净视图的指数移动平均（EMA）教师模型引导轻微扰动的学生模型，其中PTA建立软性的、依赖于表示的对应关系，FC鼓励……
tldr: 提出CLAIR框架，通过EMA教师模型引导，结合补丁级传输对齐与预测级一致性，实现无索引重编程下一致的大语言模型时间序列预测适配。
en_tdlr: Proposes CLAIR, a teacher-guided framework combining patch-level transport alignment and forecast-level consistency to achieve consistent LLM adaptation for time-series forecasting via index-free reprogramming.
